method: Final screenshots, approved C comp, durable docs and relevant source. No shared browser tools or detector output consumed.

product.answer: Kith, a private relationship-memory app for iPhone.

audience.answer: People remembering context about family, friends and meaningful relationships.

value.answer: Remember how you met, what matters now and dated moments to show up thoughtfully.

mechanism.answer: Per-person context and moments organized by manually chosen closeness.

proof.answer: Labeled actual app screen/full-size access distinct from illustrative photography.

next_action.answer: Honest internal TestFlight status or inspect real app; no public invite/App Store availability promised.

findings.fix: Optional future product-owned decorative lettering; no required change.
